conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const tz='America/Montevideo'; const now=DateTime.now().setZone(tz).startOf('day'); const jsDow=now.toJSDate().getDay(); const sat=now.minus({days:(jsDow+1)%7}); const f=(d)=>d.plus({days:(6-d.weekday+7)%7}); const curr=sat.startOf('month'); const prevEnd=curr.minus({days:1}); const prev=prevEnd.startOf('month'); const meso=sat.hasSame(f(prevEnd),'day')?prev:curr; return sat.hasSame(f(meso.endOf('month').startOf('day')),'day'); })() }}
